dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly shaped 'O' and open 'C' structures exhibit thin, high-contrast light-grey perimeters (1-3 pixels wide) against a charcoal-black ground. Sharp gradient transitions are visible at the outer perimeters, while interiors display a lower-contrast mottled grey.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of small, asymmetrical clusters of solid high-intensity light-grey pixels. These clusters are primarily distributed in the interstitial spaces between larger macro-annuli, particularly in the anterior-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-lateral section define an obtuse triangle. A cluster of four high-intensity blobs located in the anterior-dorsal region forms an irregular quadrilateral relative to the primary longitudinal axis.
